title: Sajana azakhana
body:
Sajana azakhana
Azakhana, azakhana.(2)
14 ho alam, ek mashkiza
besheer ka ek nanha jhula
do baaliya'n choti bibi ki
ek shamma jalakar tum rakhna aur yaad mein ho ek dulha ki
kuch mehendi kangana aur sehra
ghar mein yu azaa khana jo saja
paoge bohot zahra ki dua..(2)
<<MINI>>
zahra ki dua paana sajana azakhana..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ae ehle aza e shahe huda
is deher mein jab tak ho zinda
tehzeeb e azadari hai yehi
do kaam zaruri tum karna..(2)
majlis mein chale aana, sajana azakhana
<<MINI>>
zahra ki dua paana sajana azakhana..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. An amta alayhim ki ayat
ya phir rehman ka ho surah
shamil hai azakhana usmein
nemat ka jaha'n bhi zikr hua..(2)
nemat ko na thukrana, sajana azakhana
<<MINI>>
zahra ki dua paana sajana azakhana..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Be dast hua saqqa lekin
usne na alam ko jhukne diya
pehchan e aza khana hai alam
paigham yehi abbas ka tha..(2)
duniya se na ghabrana, sajana azakhana
<<MINI>>
zahra ki dua paana sajana azakhana
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Tazeem kabhi na kam karna
ta hashr rahe hurmat baaqi
ye sirf azakhana hi nahi
armaan e dile zahra hai yehi..(2)
bachho'n ko ye samjhana, sajana azakhana
<<MINI>>
zahra ki dua paana sajana azakhana
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Jis waqt chhida tha mashkiza
jab aayi khabar ghazi na raha
kuch kooze pyaase baccho ke
haatho'n se gire aur toot gaye..(2)
kuch kooze bhi rakhwana, sajana azakhana
<<MINI>>
zahra ki dua paana sajana azakhana
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Rahib ki tarha mil jaye pisar
ya hurr ke tarha bakhshe jao
fir shukr adaa karne ke liye
tum bhi ye saleeqa apnao..(2)
aise ho ye shukrana, sajana azakhana
<<MINI>>
zahra ki dua paana sajana azakhana
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Shabbir ye zainab se bole
kuch kaam abhi bhi baaqi hai
zalim jo shaheedo'n ke sar de
wo pehle azakhane mein sajein..(2)
jab shaam bahan jaana, sajana azakhana
<<MINI>>
zahra ki dua paana sajana azakhana
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Salman ke meesum ke jis din
aamal liye jayein yakja
jab tum se sawaal malak puche
duniya mein kiya kya kaam bhala..(2)
tum fakhr se likhwana, sajana azakhana
<<MINI>>
zahra ki dua paana sajana azakhana
